spans.s: मोह m. 1. Swoon, fainting, वृत्तिं मोहेन संस्तंभयतेंद्रियाणाम् K.S.iii.73; 2. delusion, perplexity, confusion, यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पांडवं Bg.iv.35; 3. ignorance, folly, infatuation, प्रांशुलभ्ये फले मोहाद् (v.l.) उद्बाहुरिव वामनः R.i.3; 4. wonder, astonishment; 5. pain, affliction; 6. a magical art employed to bewilder an enemy; 7. delusion of mind which prevents the discernment of truth.
मोह-कलिल n. the snare of illusion.
मोह-रात्रि f. the night of universal destruction.
मोहन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Stupefying; 2. perplexing, puzzling; 3. deluding.
मोहन (II) m. 1. An epithet of Śiva; 2. name of one of the five arrows of the god of love; 3. the thorn-apple.
मोहन (III) n. 1. Stupefying; 2. perplexing, puzzling; 3. temptation, seduction; 4. sexual intercourse; 5. a charm employed to bewilder an enemy.
मोहन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Stupefying; 2. perplexing, puzzling; 3. deluding.
मोहन-अस्त्र n. a weapon which fascinates the person against whom it is directed.
मोहनक m. The month of Chaitra.
मोहित a. (f. ता) 1. Stupefied; 2. deluded; 3. fascinated, infatuated.
मोहित a. (f. ता) 1. Stupefied; 2. deluded; 3. fascinated, infatuated.
मोहिनी f. 1. Viṣṇu in the form of a fascinating woman; 2. name of an apsaras; 3. the flower of a kind of jasmine.
